subject: general
question: Identify a type of season that is NOT a part of the four seasons of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**The southeast monsoon season**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **four seasons of India** as per the Indian Meteorological Department are:

 
 
• The cold weather season (Winter)
 
• The hot weather season (Summer)
 
• The southwest monsoon season (Rainy season)
